blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Toledo Xignex Trojans came agonizingly close to capturing their first-ever Wesley So Cup title in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) but fell short against Manila AQ Prime Assets in a closely contested championship showdown on Wednesday night, November 25.
